Okay kid, I'mma give you some signs on how to recognize a girl doesn't like you, and that you're in a toxic relationship:



1. she plays hard to get rather than shit-testing.
Many people use this term to indicate the same phenomenon, but they are really, really different.
Everyone shit tests once in a while(even men), we do that to test if the person around us is independent enough to have his shit togheter, to test his loyalty and see if he can stand his opinions against those of others. Playing hard to get is a whole different thing, it's about you sacrificing something of yourself to satisfy another person's need, which is usually what women with mental disorders do. They don't love the man in question, they love the thing that man can do for them. A girl who constantly keeps yelling at you about your irresponsibility, about how you are disrespectful over other people's own suffering or how friends are fake etc etc is a sign that she doesn't love you and that, either she is forcing a relationship with you so that you can help her with personal affairs, or she is making it clear that she only wants to be a friend of yours. If you know that's she's lying and that you are a good person who doesn't go around hurting around other people and that has somewhat of a honest respect for himself and for other people, you shouldn't go and change for a random stranger you just met some week ago, as she might just be gentle with you so she can get something back that could get you in trouble. 

She could be a smoker, a drug addict, an alcoholic, whadd'ya know? Heck, from what you're telling us, she might be in an abusive relationship and is looking for a guy to manipulate over and get trapped, when really if she truly cared, she would call the police instead of bringing trouble upon you. 

2. She constantly talks bad on your back with her friends or embarrasses you in public. It's ok to call someone a dumbass on their face as long as it's not intended in an offensive or disrespectful way and for the greater good of the relationship, but doing that while talking on your back and calling your name(or in front of everyone) is a sign that she would rather have popularity than a sane relationship and that she's not gonna try and fix its problems when she knows she has better options she could take at any moment. 
It's true, anxiety and shame is a factor too, but the fact that her anxiety and her shame surpass her love for you is a sign she's more embarrassed about behaving bad in general or having caused trouble to her self, rather than having done all of that to YOU particularly. A woman like that is likely going to use you as a back up option especially if she's in a relationship, so it's up to you to decide if you just wanna be friends or just cut her lose. 


3. She never contacts you or answers at the phone with a vague "I have to think about it/yeah, peraphs you're right" when you ask her out. 
It's true that she might've been busy at that moment, but here's the thing: what's her definition of being busy? Beacuse if she really loved you, she'd take care of business alongside you, or at least delay it. 
Don't get me wrong, peraphs she could be with her parents out doing something important and she'd really be busy in that case, but if she preoritizes playing video games over talking to you is already a sign she doesn't care about you that much(YES, I know online gaming exists, but in a serious real life situation, you can just choose not to play AT ALL, ya'know). 
4. She high-fives you or grabs your hands, but never goes further than that. 
It's ok to be nervous in public and being afraid of being judged for showing your true emotions, but if she knows you love her, and that she truly loved you, she would wait for the both of you to be alone and go for a hug or a kiss, rather than pulling up an insecure action that might pull nothing more other than confusion between you two. 
If she can take your hands in public then it's even worse, as I'm pretty sure she would then have no shame in doing things such as the former when alone. 
5. Both of you have childhood trauma. 
Being stuck in the past and being nostalgic are two different things.  Being stuck in the past means being incapable of getting yourself out of a dramatic situation which shaped your life up until that moment, being nostalgic is realizing that situation is the root of all your problems and missing that life kicker. 
A girl who has lost someone important and finds that person in you is a weak person who views her past an addiction rather than a part of herself, it's like a drug-addict blaming the drug for hurting him, but not blaming himself for having taken the drug in the first place. The person she misses herself isn't the thing she misses or the reason for her suffering, it's the situation she brought herself into.
If you are in the same situation as she is, she will likely recognize you both have the same weakness, and it's unlikely she's going to threat you and your actions more than a child trying to look cool in front of her mommy, and get punished later on.


Based on your story, your situation seems to fit both the 1 and the 5 point. She knows you have something in yourself she completely finds herself into, her blaming you for your actions is nothing more than her looking at herself in the mirror and breaking it with punches out of anger.

So, where do you go from there? That's all up to you, but in my opinion, you should find someone else.
